title: Pure Koa'ki Meiru
summary: Pure Koa'ki Meiru is an aggressive Rock and Beast-Warrior stun-and-swarm strategy centered around the four Level 4 Rock stun brothers—Guardian (monster negate), Overload (summon negate), Wall (Spell negate), and Sandman (Trap negate)—alongside Koa'ki Meiru Supplier and Urnight. Reveal Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru in your hand with Urnight to summon a Level 4 Koa'ki Meiru directly from your Deck, while Supplier Special Summons itself from hand whenever a Rock hits the GY to search Diamond Core of Koa'ki Meiru (which searches any Koa'ki Meiru card and banishes itself from the GY to make all your Koa'ki Meiru monsters indestructible for the entire turn, bypassing their End Phase maintenance costs!).

allow.Core Transport Unit: Continuous Spell that discards 1 card once per turn to add 1 Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru from your Deck to your hand.
allow.Ties of the Brethren: Pays 2000 LP and targets 1 Level 4 EARTH Rock Koa'ki Meiru you control (Guardian, Overload, Wall, Sandman, or Supplier) to Special Summon 2 other Level 4 EARTH Rock Koa'ki Meirus with different names directly from your Deck—putting Monster, Spell, and Summon negates on the board simultaneously!
allow.Adamancipator Signs: Revives any Rock-Type Koa'ki Meiru monster (Guardian, Overload, Wall, Sandman, or Supplier) from your GY with zero cost.
allow.Fire Formation - Tenki: Continuous Spell that searches Beast-Warrior starter Koa'ki Meiru Urnight or Koa'ki Meiru Crusader and boosts their ATK by 100.
allow.Gallant Granite: Rank 4 EARTH Rock Xyz made with any two Level 4 Koa'ki Meiru monsters that detaches 1 material to search Koa'ki Meiru Supplier, Guardian, Overload, Wall, or Sandman directly from your Deck!
allow.Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger Kin: Rank 4 Beast-Warrior Xyz made with Urnight + Crusader that sets Fire Formation - Tenki directly from the Deck.
allow.Missus Radiant: Link-2 EARTH monster that boosts all EARTH Koa'ki Meiru monsters on the field by 500 ATK/DEF.

main: Koa'ki Meiru Supplier

Core Level 4 EARTH Rock extender: Special Summons itself from your hand whenever a face-up Rock monster you control is sent to the GY, and searches any 'Koa'ki Meiru' card from your Deck when Special Summoned!
Koa'ki Meiru Guardian
Level 4 EARTH Rock (1900 ATK): tributes itself as a Quick Effect when a monster effect is activated to negate the activation and destroy that monster.
Koa'ki Meiru Overload
Level 4 EARTH Rock (1900 ATK): tributes itself as a Quick Effect when your opponent would Summon a monster(s) to negate the Summon and destroy that monster(s).
Koa'ki Meiru Wall
Level 4 EARTH Rock (1900 ATK): tributes itself as a Quick Effect when your opponent activates a Spell Card to negate the activation and destroy it.
Koa'ki Meiru Sandman
Level 4 EARTH Rock (1900 ATK): tributes itself as a Quick Effect when your opponent activates a Trap Card to negate the activation and destroy it.
Koa'ki Meiru Urnight
Core Level 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior (2000 ATK): reveals 1 Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru in your hand once per turn to Special Summon any Level 4 or lower 'Koa'ki Meiru' monster directly from your Deck!
Koa'ki Meiru Crusader
Level 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior (1900 ATK): adds 1 'Koa'ki Meiru' card from your GY to your hand whenever it destroys an opponent's monster by battle.
Koa'ki Meiru Maximus
Level 8 WIND Dragon boss (3000 ATK): banishes 1 Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru from your hand to Special Summon itself and destroys 1 card your opponent controls every turn.
Diamond Core of Koa'ki Meiru

Core Spell: adds any 'Koa'ki Meiru' card (except itself) from your Deck to your hand, AND banishes itself from your GY so Koa'ki Meiru monsters you control cannot be destroyed for the rest of this turn.
Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru
Signature Spell: revealed in hand to pay maintenance costs and activate Urnight's Deck-summon effect, and adds itself from the GY to your hand during your Draw Phase.
Core Transport Unit
Continuous Spell that discards 1 card once per turn to add 1 Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru from your Deck to your hand.
Ties of the Brethren
Targets 1 Level 4 EARTH Rock Koa'ki Meiru to summon 2 others from the Deck—setting up Guardian + Overload + Wall on Turn 1!
Fire Formation - Tenki
Searches Koa'ki Meiru Urnight or Crusader and keeps a Beast-Warrior / Continuous Spell presence.
Adamancipator Signs
Revives Guardian, Overload, Wall, or Supplier from the GY.
extra: Rank 4 EARTH Rock Xyz (2 Level 4 monsters): detaches 1 material to add Koa'ki Meiru Supplier, Guardian, Overload, Wall, or Sandman from your Deck to your hand.
Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger King
Rank 4 Beast-Warrior Xyz made with Urnight + Crusader that sets Fire Formation - Tenki from the Deck.
Link-2 EARTH monster that boosts all EARTH Koa'ki Meiru beatsticks to 2400–2500 ATK and recovers a Koa'ki Meiru when destroyed.
